ios.desc:
Discover the World with Your Personal AI Audio Guide


Transform your travel experience with MonumentAI, the advanced landmark scanner and digital tour guide. Point your camera at any monument, statue, or building, and let AI 
identify it instantly to tell you its story.



Whether you are a solo traveler, a history buff, or just curious, MonumentAI replaces boring guidebooks with engaging audio stories.


Why MonumentAI is the Best Sightseeing Companion?
Unlike standard travel apps, we offer unique narration styles to match your mood:



• The Gossip Mode (Trending): Discover what the history books hide. Listen to scandals, secret romances, and shocking facts behind famous icons.
• The Historian Mode: Get precise educational facts, architectural details, and historical timelines.
• The Storyteller Mode: Enjoy immersive myths and legends told like a captivating bedtime story.


Top Features:
• Instant Landmark Recognition: Identify sights in seconds using powerful visual AI.
• Immersive Audio Tours: High-quality narration for a hands-free experience.
• Travel Log: Automatically save your scanned locations to build your personal travel diary.
• Multi-Language Support: Understand the world in your native language.


Don't just see the sights; understand them. Download MonumentAI today and unlock the stories hidden in the architecture!

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I'm Ozan, the developer behind MonumentAI.

I built this app because I enjoy traveling but find traditional audio guides and plaques incredibly boring. They usually focus on dates and architectural styles, skipping the interesting human stories—the scandals, exiles, and secrets.

I wanted a "Shazam for Buildings" that feels like a local friend whispering the gossip in your ear, rather than a history textbook.

How it works:
1. You take a photo of a landmark.
2. The app identifies the location using Google Gemini's vision capabilities.
3. It generates a short, engaging story focused on the "gossip" or hidden history (also via Gemini).

It's currently an iOS app built with SwiftUI.

The app is free to download (with a paid tier for unlimited scans), but you can try the core functionality without paying.

App Store Link: 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/monumentai-scan-explore/id6756325340

I'd love to hear your feedback on the UX and the quality of the stories.

Thanks!
